tasks.title: Freeze the decision problem and red-team corpus
tasks.implementation: Predeclare one target decision, adverse-error taxonomy, evidence-access tiers, adjudication rubric, and holdout split by original experiment family.
tasks.acceptance: At least 12 diverse public cases are screened as a coverage pilot; every label is evidence-linked or unresolved; pilot is not an efficacy sample-size claim.
tasks.stop_condition: Stop feature expansion if the recurring decision or usable evidence cannot be defined.
tasks.effort: Estimate after corpus and adapter discovery; no invented staffing or completion date.

tasks.title: Specify separate assessment dimensions
tasks.implementation: Use independent arithmetic, assay, identity, independence, comparability, and version statuses. No combined verified label.
tasks.acceptance: A valid replay with missing assay or context stays open in those dimensions in JSON, HTML, and exports.
tasks.stop_condition: Block handoff if any status is silently upgraded or omitted.
tasks.effort: Estimate after corpus and adapter discovery; no invented staffing or completion date.

tasks.title: Declare the estimand and denominator basis
tasks.implementation: Declare product/substrate/biomass identities, mass or carbon basis, feed consumed versus charged, volume basis, and time window.
tasks.acceptance: Product/biomass may replay but cannot receive substrate-yield support; unknown feed or volume basis blocks the corresponding scientific assertion.
tasks.stop_condition: Do not infer missing denominators from a dimensional unit.
tasks.effort: Estimate after corpus and adapter discovery; no invented staffing or completion date.

tasks.title: Expose paired and pooled estimators
tasks.implementation: Add explicit paired mean-of-ratios versus ratio-of-sums/means modes with source-bound pair IDs and missingness policy.
tasks.acceptance: Independent rational oracle gives 2.0 versus 2.5 on the seeded fixture; missing pair, duplicate pair, or zero denominator is explained and blocks unsupported pooling.
tasks.stop_condition: Keep current bounded mode if pair provenance is unavailable.
tasks.effort: Estimate after corpus and adapter discovery; no invented staffing or completion date.

tasks.title: Register a versioned evidence pool and membership rule
tasks.implementation: Define pool boundary, analyte/assay scope, candidate predicate, missing-metadata handling, and monotone registry event watermark.
tasks.acceptance: New matching evidence outside the old dependency closure creates a membership delta; nonmatching evidence does not; uncertain matching stays reviewable.
tasks.stop_condition: Never describe a registry watermark as completeness of world literature.
tasks.effort: Estimate after corpus and adapter discovery; no invented staffing or completion date.

tasks.title: Reassess additions, withdrawals, and eligibility changes
tasks.implementation: Reassessment covers membership deltas, source revisions, changed policies, corrections, withdrawals and later-restored access where supported.
tasks.acceptance: Independent set-difference oracle checks additions/removals; interrupted ingestion/restart cannot lose an event; old decision and replay remain unchanged.
tasks.stop_condition: Block a current-for-pool claim if event coverage is unknown.
tasks.effort: Estimate after corpus and adapter discovery; no invented staffing or completion date.

tasks.title: Make genotype assertions explicitly scoped
tasks.implementation: Separate operator assertion from assessed observation; include material, time/generation, assay, covered region, population/clone, and limitations.
tasks.acceptance: An arbitrary note remains an assertion and cannot satisfy an observed-genotype requirement; missing reads or limited assay coverage stays explicit.
tasks.stop_condition: Do not certify the whole genotype from a partial check or attachment.
tasks.effort: Estimate after corpus and adapter discovery; no invented staffing or completion date.

tasks.title: Represent experimental units and overlapping evidence
tasks.implementation: Use experimental-unit IDs, sampling/aliquot/acquisition hierarchy, plate/run/batch blocks, shared inoculum and source-overlap declarations.
tasks.acceptance: Renaming an aliquot does not increase independent n; common controls and reused literature data are not double-counted; unresolved identity blocks independence support.
tasks.stop_condition: Distinct labels alone must never establish independence.
tasks.effort: Estimate after corpus and adapter discovery; no invented staffing or completion date.

tasks.title: Add process trajectories and transfer scope
tasks.implementation: Version setpoints and realized pH/DO/feed/volume trajectories; align instrument and sample clocks and preserve missing intervals.
tasks.acceptance: Constant and oscillating profiles remain distinct despite matching nominal context; timezone drift and gaps produce explicit uncertainty.
tasks.stop_condition: Do not automatically extrapolate strain rankings to a new regime or scale.
tasks.effort: Estimate after corpus and adapter discovery; no invented staffing or completion date.

tasks.title: Attach assay validation and QC evidence
tasks.implementation: Represent proxy/direct identity, standards, raw integration, internal standard, matrix/recovery, range, drift, and calibration fit evidence.
tasks.acceptance: Proxy and direct assays cannot be equated by unit alone; supplied QC pass without supporting evidence remains an assertion; out-of-range/censored values stay visible.
tasks.stop_condition: Do not build a universal mass-spectrometry validator; begin with one validated assay.
tasks.effort: Estimate after corpus and adapter discovery; no invented staffing or completion date.

tasks.title: Propagate uncertainty and preserve dependence
tasks.implementation: Represent calibration covariance, shared standards, replicate structure, dilution/volume contributions, censoring and missing uncertainty.
tasks.acceptance: Independent analytical or simulation oracle checks propagation and common-mode cancellation; rank sensitivity is reported when magnitude is unidentified.
tasks.stop_condition: Never substitute extra decimal places, sample SD, or SEM for total measurement uncertainty.
tasks.effort: Estimate after corpus and adapter discovery; no invented staffing or completion date.

tasks.title: Implement a bounded cross-project evidence handoff
tasks.owner_role: Integration engineer + reviewer from each project
tasks.implementation: Pin schema, producer code, source bytes, source locations, independent status dimensions, declared mappings, and intended use.
tasks.acceptance: Round-trip unknown/open/conflict statuses without strengthening them; reject unknown schema, changed hash, invalid mapping, or scope mismatch.
tasks.stop_condition: Import as literature evidence; never silently convert a publication result into a local wet-lab measurement.
tasks.effort: Estimate after corpus and adapter discovery; no invented staffing or completion date.

tasks.title: Classify corrections and prioritize review
tasks.implementation: Classify numerical, methodological, identity, authorship and unknown deltas; retain rationale and unresolved cases.
tasks.acceptance: The author-name correction fixture changes bibliographic metadata without claiming numeric invalidity; calibration corrections still reopen affected decisions.
tasks.stop_condition: Do not auto-dismiss unclassified or consequential changes.
tasks.effort: Estimate after corpus and adapter discovery; no invented staffing or completion date.

tasks.title: Run blinded comparative task evaluation
tasks.implementation: Compare current workflow, configured existing platform, and platform plus this layer using matched tasks and balanced order.
tasks.acceptance: Measure serious unsupported assertions, missed changes, useful coverage, false alerts, and total setup/curation/review time; report clustered confidence intervals.
tasks.stop_condition: Reject standalone-product direction if an existing extension performs equivalently with less burden.
tasks.effort: Estimate after corpus and adapter discovery; no invented staffing or completion date.

tasks.title: Test reproducibility and recovery at measured workloads
tasks.implementation: Define measured instrument workload, query mix, lineage depth/fan-out, object sizes, concurrency, privacy model, backup and restore objectives.
tasks.acceptance: Restart/replay, raw-object corruption, partial writes, blocked access, event replay, and backpressure tests pass against fixed declared SLOs.
tasks.stop_condition: Do not claim hundreds-of-millions-row scale from the existing small benchmark.
tasks.effort: Estimate after corpus and adapter discovery; no invented staffing or completion date.

tasks.title: Evaluate ML export and decision utility
tasks.implementation: Export provenance groups, uncertainty/missingness, frozen transformation versions, temporal holdouts and intended target domain.
tasks.acceptance: Split by original experiment/lineage/batch/time; fit transforms on training only; compare simple baselines and calibration/OOD behavior; evaluate next-experiment value.
tasks.stop_condition: Do not call traceable data ML-ready or add a recommendation engine without comparative benefit.
tasks.effort: Estimate after corpus and adapter discovery; no invented staffing or completion date.

tasks.title: Validate with a laboratory and existing platform
tasks.implementation: Run a real acquisition-to-decision replay and a correction/new-evidence challenge using permitted data in the current ELN/LIMS.
tasks.acceptance: An independent scientist can inspect exclusions and reproduce the bounded decision with preserved identities; measured burden meets the preregistered target.
tasks.stop_condition: Industrial validation remains blocked until a partner and permissible data exist.
tasks.effort: Estimate after corpus and adapter discovery; no invented staffing or completion date.

tasks.title: Publish an evidence-limited release assessment
tasks.implementation: Publish scope, failures, access gaps, benchmark intervals, test identities, dependency versions and outstanding risks.
tasks.acceptance: Every release claim maps to a completed gate and retained evidence; draft, local, external and industrial validation are distinguished.
tasks.stop_condition: Do not promote the reference v1.0 tag into an industrial maturity claim.
tasks.effort: Estimate after corpus and adapter discovery; no invented staffing or completion date.
